name: bess-design-studio

scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx -y firebase-tools@latest deploy
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm run build && npx -y firebase-tools@latest deploy --only hosting
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project bessstudio-rules-test "vitest run --config vitest.rules.config.ts"
scripts.validate: vitest run --config vitest.validation.config.ts validation/export-cases.test.ts && python3 validation/sam_reference.py && python3 validation/compare.py
scripts.test:browser: npm run build && vitest run --config vitest.browser.config.ts
scripts.plates: vitest run --config vitest.validation.config.ts validation/lesson-plates.test.ts && python3 validation/plates.py

description: BESS Studio — sizing, engineering visualisation and quotation for battery energy storage. Developed and managed by jouleWise Technologies.
